document.title: Security audit 2026-11-07 (2): deprecated button API change and NULL check

acknowledgments.summary: audit of pull request fix/deprecated-button-api before merge, directed by the maintainer

notes.title: Summary
notes.text: Audit of the change that replaces the deprecated obs_properties_add_button with obs_properties_add_button2, which fixes the Ubuntu CI build (newer OBS marks the old call deprecated and the build treats warnings as errors). The API change itself introduces no issues. One low-severity pre-existing robustness gap was found and fixed in the same change.

notes.title: Scope and areas found sound
notes.text: Reviewed: src/nixie-countdown.c button callbacks and nixie_properties. obs_properties_add_button2 stores the source's data as the button's private pointer, and libobs passes it to the callback; when it is NULL, libobs falls back to the source's own data, matching the old behavior. The context bar (context-bar.cpp) still calls obs_property_button_clicked on properties built from a live source, so it always receives valid data. No change to locking, buffers or input handling.

notes.title: Affected and fixed versions
notes.text: Affected: main up to 3850bc1. Fixed: the merge of pull request fix/deprecated-button-api, which adds this log.

vulnerabilities.title: Property button callbacks dereference data without a NULL check

notes.title: Summary
notes.text: button_start, button_pause and button_reset passed their data pointer to the timer actions, which lock n->mutex, without checking it for NULL.

notes.title: Details and failure scenario
notes.text: Location: src/nixie-countdown.c, button_start, button_pause, button_reset. Properties can be built without a source instance (for example obs_get_source_properties with only the source type ID), in which case nixie_properties receives data == NULL. If such a button were clicked, for example by another plugin or script calling obs_property_button_clicked with no source, action_start(NULL) would dereference NULL and crash OBS. No path in OBS itself or in this plugin is known to do this.

remediations.details: Each button callback now returns early when data is NULL. The buttons are registered with obs_properties_add_button2, passing the source data explicitly.

threats.details: Low. Not known to be reachable; would need another component to press the button on instance-less properties.
